howto: Each day, check the hype calendar: a coloured dot is a sneaker drop.
Tap SNIPE, then tap again when the needle is in the gold zone to buy the pair at retail.
Tap a pair in storage and flip it into a live auction. Press SELL NOW when the top bid beats what you paid.
Hit NEXT DAY to move on. After ten weeks the run closes; your score is profit per week.
tips: A GRAIL drop is worth sniping even at a high retail price: it resells for almost double.
Late auction bids can retract. A good bid at FINAL CALL is safer than waiting for the hammer.
Grading adds up to 50% to the sale price, so grade your best pairs before you flip them.
Three good snipes in a row widen the timing window.
CASH OUT RUN locks in your profit per week early: a strong week can beat a long grind.

controls.keyboard: Space or Enter snipes, sells and continues (on the market it moves to the next day). Right arrow: next day, S: shop, Up and Down: pick a pair. P pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the buttons on screen. Drag the storage list to scroll.

difficulty: Pick Easy, Normal or Hard on the title. Easy starts with $1,200 and a wider snipe window; Hard starts with $550 and a tighter one. Each difficulty keeps its own best score.

cheats.effect: +$2,500 cash now and at the start of every run while codes are on
Every brand goes ON FIRE, so resale prices run hot
The snipe needle moves at half speed
A free grade-S AUREUM 24K lands in storage

features.goals-or-day-targets: The calendar header shows the next rank to reach (for example SOLE BROKER at $40 a week); ten weeks per run
features.economy-readout: Header shows cash, net profit and profit per week; storage rows show market value and profit or loss per pair
features.upgrade-path: SHOP: storage units, grading bench and verified-seller reputation, each with levels
features.end-of-day-summary: A WEEK CLOSED recap after every seventh day: cash change, worth gained, flip profit, drops won and the next rank goal
features.results: RUN CLOSED screen with profit per week, rank, best flip and Same seed again / New seed buttons
features.tutorial: Five coach marks on the first run point at the calendar, the snipe, storage, next day and the goal; replay from How to play
